description: A snack exporter sends snacks to his customer in small and large suitcases. A small suitcase can hold 50 snacks while a large suitcase can hold 80 snacks. Most customer prefer small suitcases, and so at least twice as many small suitcases must be used as large suitcases. The exporter has available at most 70 small suitcases and 50 large suitcases. If he must send at least 15 large suitcases and can send  at most 70 suitcases in total, how many of each should he send to maximize the total number of snacks that can be delivered?

SmallSuitcaseCapacity.definition: Capacity of a small suitcase in snacks

LargeSuitcaseCapacity.definition: Capacity of a large suitcase in snacks

MinSmallToLargeRatio.definition: Minimum ratio factor indicating that the number of small suitcases must be at least twice the number of large suitcases

MaxSmallSuitcases.definition: Maximum number of small suitcases available

MaxLargeSuitcases.definition: Maximum number of large suitcases available

MinLargeSuitcases.definition: Minimum number of large suitcases to send

MaxTotalSuitcases.definition: Maximum total number of suitcases to send

objective.description: "Maximize the total number of snacks delivered in the suitcases"
objective.code:
model.setObjective(
    SmallSuitcaseCapacity * SmallSuitcases +
    LargeSuitcaseCapacity * LargeSuitcases,
    GRB.MAXIMIZE
)

constraints.description: Number of small suitcases used must be at least twice the number of large suitcases used
Number of small suitcases used must not exceed MaxSmallSuitcases
Number of large suitcases used must be between MinLargeSuitcases and MaxLargeSuitcases
Total number of suitcases used must not exceed MaxTotalSuitcases
Number of small and large suitcases used must be integers
